RuleOrValue: Living count changes only on seeding, funded births or death. Stage/identity history is preserved. No colony-level birth quota or death-triggered global behavior branch.
Gap: Living metadata includes all live ant stages. Experimental worker census differs. No colony-level failure rule, replacement queen or worker male reproduction from queen loss.

RuleOrValue: Create a nonempty source. Surface worlds require a unique walkable food cell. Collection and delivery move the same components into carried and colony stocks.

RuleOrValue: Release componentwise min of remaining reserve and scaled pulse limits. Optional low productivity applies on odd productive spans. Continue scheduling even if the released amount is zero.

Gap: Single allocation at mother's location and copying rates preserve identity and conservation. No comparable per-egg allocation or lineage-dependent rate map was identified.

Gap: No observed recency kernel, inhibition maximum or bypass for ongoing retrieval. Worker presence/contact, workload relief and exact cue remain distinct hypotheses.
